title: Noise-Robust QCNN Generalization Report
headline_claim: QCNN robustness is strongly evaluation- and phase-family-dependent, with robust microscopic perturbation and finite-shot performance, but distinct decision-boundary calibration shift near criticality rather than loss of class ranking.
pending: Multi-session physical hardware validation across distinct calibration windows (optional future publication extension)

Known limitation: formal optimizer convergence (scipy/plateau) attained in 10.3% of Phase-23 runs; no run was truncated while actively improving, but longer-horizon or alternative optimizers remain future work
